name: AI Controls Matrix
description: CSA AI Controls Matrix v1.1.0 — current AICM release. 247 controls across 18 domains, with cross-framework mappings to BSI AI C4, the EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023. Companion to CCM for general-cloud-security controls; AICM adds AI-specific overlays. Ships as a ZIP bundle with the AICM spreadsheet, the standalone AI-CAIQ v1.1.0 questionnaire, and three PDF guidance documents.
relationToCloudSecurity: AICM controls layer on top of cloud-platform controls (covered by CCM). For AI workloads in cloud, both frameworks apply together.
relationToAISecurity: AICM is THE current cloud-industry AI controls catalog. Used in CSA STAR for AI Level 1 self-assessments.

license.notes: CSA publications are typically released under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Copyright notice in the v1.1.0 workbook reads © Copyright 2026 Cloud Security Alliance.

notes: CONTROL IDs WERE RENUMBERED IN THIS RELEASE. 55 of the 242 control IDs shared with v1.0.3 now designate a different control; only one ID (IAM-19) disappeared outright, so an ID set-difference does NOT detect the change. Never migrate a v1.0.3 reference to v1.1.0 by string match — use ../crosswalks/aicm-1.0.3-to-1.1.0-crosswalk.csv. Full analysis and standing policy in ../VERSIONING.md.

open_questions.summary: The Scope Applicability (Mappings) sheet dropped from 16 columns to 13. The NIST AI 600-1:2024 mapping block, populated for all 243 controls in v1.0.3, is absent — while the same workbook's Change Log claims mapping rows were added 'across all four external frameworks'. Only BSI AI C4, EU AI Act, and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 are present. Looks like an upstream packaging defect. Raise with the AICM working group before publishing an extraction that silently drops a mapping set consumers currently rely on.

1.0.3/scripts/parse_aicm.py raises KeyError: 13 on the mappings sheet (hardcoded NIST columns 13-15). 1.0.3/scripts/parse_caiq.py fails on a hardcoded sheet name 'AI-CAIQv1.0.2', renamed to 'AI-CAIQv1.1.0'. All other sheets parse cleanly against v1.1.0 (247 controls, 320 CAIQ questions, row geometry unchanged). Also pre-existing: parse_llm_taxonomy only reads the lifecycle section of the LLM Taxonomy sheet and silently drops the Control Type, Control Ownership, Threat Category, and new Other Definitions sections.

desired_end_state.notes: Target: AICM controls JSON plus derived CSV, matching the 1.0.3 shape. Blocked on nist-ai-600-1-mappings-missing and parser-updates-required above.
